claims: No. 1 seed UCLA defeated No. 3 seed Duke 70-58.
The game was in the 2026 NCAA Women’s Basketball Tournament Elite Eight.
UCLA rallied from a halftime deficit.
UCLA advanced to the Final Four.
Duke led by as many as 10 in the first half.
UCLA outscored Duke 39-19 in the second half.
Lauren Betts had 23 points and 10 rebounds for UCLA.
Lauren Betts had 23 points and 5 blocks for UCLA.
Angela Dugalic had 15 points for UCLA.
Taina Mair led Duke in scoring.
UCLA scored 54 points in the paint.
Duke scored 32 points in the paint.
UCLA earned their second consecutive Final Four appearance.
UCLA reached the Final Four for the second consecutive season.
